claims.claim: DINOv3: classification improves monotonically but VOC linear segmentation declines after ~200k iterations for ViT-g and ViT-7B; patch-[CLS] similarity grows; Gram anchoring pulls student patch Gram matrix toward early teacher; observed mildly in DINOv2
I-JEPA: invariance-based methods rely on hand-crafted augmentations whose biases may hurt some downstream tasks and do not generalize to other modalities
MMVP: CLIP-blind pairs (CLIP cosine >0.95, DINOv2 <0.6); MoF mixing DINOv2 features improves MLLM visual grounding
Web-SSL: DINOv2-style models trained on MC-2B reach CLIP-level average VQA at 7B; CLIP excels at OCR & Chart, Web-DINO at vision-centric
